breakdown.description: The domain height and initial water column are oriented along the Y-axis, but the gravity vector is set to the -Z direction, which will not cause the dam to break downwards.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the gravity vector. The original prompt incorrectly set gravity to act in the -Z direction `(0 0 -9.81)`, while the simulation domain's height is along the Y-axis. The Agent repeated this error, stating `Gravity is set to (0 0 -9.81) m/s²`. The ground truth correctly identifies that the gravity vector should be `(0 -9.81 0)` for the simulation to work as intended.
